title: An analytical model to explain under which conditions home batteries create new load peaks in the local grid
abstract: arXiv:2611.01286v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Simulation studies find that price-responsive home batteries and electric vehicles create new load peaks in low-voltage grids; with endogenous wholesale prices most of these peaks disappear. This paper explains both findings with an analytical model of the coincident peak at the transformer. The model is algebraic and solved in closed form, so the parameters that determine whether a new peak emerges and how large it becomes can be identified; they are few. The peak is the background load in the critical hour plus the charging of the local fleet. Under exogenous prices the charging equals the rated power of the fleet. Under endogenous prices the national fleet fills the trough of residual load until the price is flat; the depth of the fill follows from an energy balance in which the price function does not appear. For a V-shaped trough the local charging peak is the share of the grid in national flexibility times the square root of flank

translated_title: 一个解释家用电池在何种条件下于本地电网产生新负荷峰值的解析模型
translated_abstract: 仿真研究发现，对价格敏感的家用电池和电动汽车会在低压电网中产生新的负荷峰值；而当批发价格内生的条件下，这些峰值大多会消失。本文通过一个变压器处同时峰值的解析模型解释了这两个发现。该模型是代数形式并以闭式解求解，因此能够识别决定新峰值是否出现及其大小的参数；而且这些参数数量很少。该峰值等于临界小时内的背景负荷加上本地车队的充电量。在外生价格下，充电量等于车队的额定功率。在内生价格下，全国车队会填补残余负荷的谷值直到价格变平；填补深度由能量平衡推导得出，其中价格函数并不出现。对于V形谷值，本地充电峰值等于电网在全国灵活性中所占份额乘以谷值侧翼的平方根。
tldr: 本文提出了一个变压器同时峰值的闭式代数解析模型，用极少数参数解释了为什么价格响应型家用电池和电动车在外生电价下会在低压电网中产生新负荷峰值，而在内生批发电价下这些峰值大多消失。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a closed-form analytical model of the coincident peak at the transformer, identifying the few parameters that explain why price-responsive home batteries and EVs create new load peaks in low-voltage grids under exogenous prices, while most of these peaks disappear when wholesale prices are endogenous.
